name: NavItem
purpose: A single entry in a persistent navigation list (a SideNav, a tab rail) that links to another view.
neverUseFor: Triggering an action (saving, deleting, opening a dialog) — use Button, which Button.json's own neverUseFor list already forbids for navigation
External links that leave the app — still usable, but set target/rel explicitly at the usage site
A single standalone link inside body text — use a plain <a>, styled separately

authored.name: current
authored.description: This item represents the current view.

anatomy.description: Root — always a native <a href>, never a <button>.

The current-item background, absolutely positioned behind icon/label. Shares a Motion layoutId across every NavItem instance (ADR-007) so it slides to the newly-current item instead of the background cutting over.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, passed by reference. Rendered at a fixed 16px.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks this item as representing the current view.

properties.name: current
properties.description: In code the current fill is the sliding nav-item-indicator (motion.span); Figma puts it on the root.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis. hover/focus are CSS pseudo-classes in code (hover only changes a non-current item).

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Show/hide part: the leading icon. The 8px gap only exists between two shown children (flex gap / auto-layout), so hiding it leaves the paddings untouched.
